verdict.rationale: Datalab documents an official Python SDK covering conversion, pipelines, structured extraction, form filling, and file management, with dedicated SDK doc pages and a bundled CLI. Only Python is evidenced, and the OpenAPI probe found no machine-readable spec for generating clients in other languages. Missing for 10: SDKs in other languages (e.g. TypeScript/JS), a published OpenAPI spec for client generation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
